lines.say: Over five thousand hardened criminals in Florida, set free, if the ruling reached old cases. That was Florida's warning to the Supreme Court.
lines.show: "Over 5,000 hardened criminals in Florida," set free, if the ruling reached old cases. That was Florida's warning to the Supreme Court.

lines.say: Its own survey: four thousand sixty-five prisoners had pleaded guilty with no lawyer.
lines.show: Its own survey: 4,065 prisoners had pleaded guilty with no lawyer.

lines.say: The case was Clarence Earl Gideon's. Five years for a poolroom break-in, tried without counsel. The Court sided with him anyway. Lawyers, it said, are necessities, not luxuries.

lines.say: Florida's own lawyer later wrote: about twelve hundred were set free.
